blocks.tamil_translation: charity. (The second) if one who is wronged observes patience, Allah Ta'ala raises his honour because of that patience. (The third) whoever takes up the habit of begging from people, Allah Ta'ala will open for him the door of poverty”. Then the Prophet ﷺ said, “I will tell you something; remember it. There are four kinds of people in the world. The first kind of person: Allah Ta'ala had given him wealth and knowledge of the Deen. (Through his knowledge) he fears Allah Ta'ala about his wealth (as to whether he is spending it in a way pleasing to Allah Ta'ala or not), (and) whether he is spending it in keeping ties of kinship or not. He also knows that there is a right of Allah Ta'ala in this wealth. (So he spends the wealth in good ways.) He will be in a very high rank on the Day of Qiyamah. The second kind of person: Allah Ta'ala gave him knowledge of the Deen but did not give him wealth. He is a person of true intention. And he wishes, “If I too had got wealth, I too would spend (in good ways) like so-and-so.' So (Allah Ta'ala), because of his good intention, (gives him reward like the former) and in this way the reward of both of them becomes equal. The third kind of person: Allah Ta'ala had given him wealth. But He did not give him knowledge of the Deen. Out of ignorance he spends his wealth in the wrong way (wastefully).
